name: Commitments
tagline: Logs the promises you make at work and holds them open till done
description: Agreeing to something in passing is the easiest work to lose track of. Promises this spots in Slack, Notion or email are each written to a Notion database row, and the row stays open until the thing is finished. A short daily check keeps the open ones in view so they do not quietly expire.
author: samlambert
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
